author: Ayush Kumar (India), with Claude
basis: plate readings of 14 circle-dot sides (CISI vol. 1 pp. 230-232, vol. 2 p. 337), all 2 or 3; no hold-out involved (the third side is in no corpus)

predictions.falsifier: on >= 15 newly read sides, >= 3 carry 1, 4 or more circle-dots
predictions.scope: any incised tablet (any site) with a side carrying a row of circle-dots, not yet read by us

predictions.falsifier: not a falsifiable claim; registered to fix the two hypotheses before more sides are read
predictions.predicted: undetermined; if the circles are a second notation of the same value the share will exceed 0.85; if an independent mark it will sit near the chance level for two values (~0.5)
predictions.scope: three-sided incised tablets with a legible cup+strokes side and a legible circle-dot side, not yet read by us
predictions.stat: share with circle count = stroke count
